summary: Glass House Brands Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, attaching an investor presentation (Ex-99.1) titled 'Investor Sesh V.' The presentation outlines the company's operational highlights, including its cultivation footprint, cost structure, and legislative opportunities from cannabis rescheduling and export. No transaction, merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or special structure is announced. The filing is a routine update for investors with no corporate action (e.g., M&A, spin-off, or capital return). As a non-US filing, Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a US Form 8-K, but the content is purely promotional and operational, not triggering any special-situation classification.
